item.title:
An essential tool for prediction markets

in our world, we mostly trade on news

to trade better, it’s crucial to hear about news before everyone else

I’ve spent the whole week looking for a tool for this

and I finally found an app called Ratio

my goal now is to show you the real value of this product

it’s a genuinely convenient way to trade the news.

there’s also a leaderboard - both global and just among your friends

a real example:

> I opened the app
> saw a piece of news about Venezuela (screenshot attached)
> went to the market
> evaluated the situation

I learned about news that could flip the outcome of a market faster than 99% of traders

that’s the main advantage of this tool

right now access is invite‑only

the app is available on the Play Market and the App Store (UK/Canada)

https://t.co/wqHljCCzM0 // XWGHU6EX
